title: Detecting Inconsistent Persona Maintenance as a Deception Signal

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Moderate chain: consistency checking as deception signal -> low-cost monitoring layer. However, the link between consistency and deception is speculative; honest models may also show inconsistencies, and deceptive models may maintain perfect consistency. Needs validation.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Multi-turn conversation design and consistency scoring are accessible. Requires prompt engineering to create honest vs. deceptive conditions and measuring consistency via automated comparison. Within beginner reach.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Need to design conversations, create honest/deceptive conditions, measure consistency, and test separation. The experimental design for inducing deception conditions adds complexity. Feasible in 30 hours with a simple setup.
